items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: So when I told my sister Sady, I said, I'm going to get married.

ctx.x: Now listen, I, alright. Now he was playing music with my sister. Uh-huh, yeah. See? And I was playing in another band, see? Oh, I bet you, yeah. See? Now he was working in one block, like this block, and I was working in the next block, on Decatur Street. So finally, I said, if you don't tell him I like him, I'm going to tell him myself. She said, well, you tell him. I'm sure I'm going to tell him. So my sister used to come and pick me up, you see, when she knocked off before I was, she'd come pick me up. Well,…
